3) «Bulk creation» makes many one-time codes; safest for public campaigns.
4) In each coupon's details, «Deeplink» builds the UserBot direct Start link.
5) «QR deeplink» is for print, stories, channels or image sharing of that link.

7) «User limit» is that code's total consumption cap; use 1 for dedicated codes.
8) Set «Expiry duration» in hours; 0 means unlimited.
9) «Usage report» shows which user, when, with which code and wallet balance received a gift.
10) «Abuse control» turns off expired/depleted coupons and shows protections.
